IC2: - Subjects should be capable of walking, [OR] ascending/ [OR] descending stairs [AND] and ramps with full capability in lower extremity passive range of motion (knee flexion contracture of >10 degrees, knee flexion ROM < 90 degrees, hip flexion contracture < 25 degrees, [AND] and ankle plantar flexion contracture of >15 degrees).
IC3: - Subjects must be able to walk for at least 5 minutes [AND] and willing and able to participate over a 1-6 hours experiment with breaks and rest enforced regularly and as needed.
IC4: - Subjects must be able to transfer (sit-to-stand [AND] and stand-to-sit) with no external support (arm rests OK) and to ambulate over small slopes (3 degrees) [AND] and a few steps (6 steps).
